bluemap_minimap.config_hint: Click a button to change it / Done saves your settings
bluemap_minimap.tooltip.enabled: Turn the entire minimap display on or off.
bluemap_minimap.tooltip.size: Cycle through seven minimap width and height sizes.
bluemap_minimap.tooltip.zoom: Change how many blocks each pixel represents. A larger value shows a wider area.
bluemap_minimap.tooltip.position: Choose the screen corner where the minimap is displayed.
bluemap_minimap.tooltip.orientation: Keep north at the top or rotate the map to keep your heading at the top.
bluemap_minimap.tooltip.players: Show online BlueMap players as head icons. Mobs and minecarts are never included.
bluemap_minimap.tooltip.names: Show player names beside their icons inside the minimap.
bluemap_minimap.tooltip.compass: Show an N marker for north inside the minimap.
bluemap_minimap.tooltip.coordinates: Show your current coordinates below the minimap.
bluemap_minimap.tooltip.cancel: Discard changes made on this screen and restore the saved settings.
bluemap_minimap.tooltip.done: Save the current settings and return to the game.
